The instant petition has been filed praying for a direction to respondent no. 2 to pay
compensation to the petitioners in accordance with the provisions of the Right to Fair
Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

2.  The petitioners claim to be owners of Arazi No. 164, area 1.461 hectare and Arazi No. 148, area 0.575 hectare, situated in Village Ratanpur, Tappa Nagawa Teekar, Pargana Sihal, Tehsil Rudrapur,
District Deoria.

entities.text: Sampurnanand Singh And Another vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
The petitioners allege that the respondents are pressurizing them to enter into compromise and accept compensation for their land, which they require for their project "Pachladi Embankment".
4.
Sri Rajiv Gupta, learned Additional Chief Standing Counsel, is in receipt of instructions.
He does not dispute that some part of land of the petitioners is required for the aforesaid project.
He submits that majority of the villagers have already executed sale deeds in favour of the State.

He further submits that in case the petitioners do not agree to sell their land, the respondents would acquire it under the provisions of the relevant statutes and pay compensation to them accordingly.
5. Having regard to said statement, we dispose of the instant petition in terms thereof.
6. The order has been passed in the presence of Sri Sudhir Bharti, learned counsel appearing on behalf of respondent no. 4.

(Donadi Ramesh, J.) (Manoj Kumar Gupta, J.) Order Date :- 9.8.2023 Jaideep/-
